evidence.decision: Chooses clear global search versus justified local scope, meaningful metadata/suggestions and privacy-aware history clearing.
evidence.artifact: Requires corpus/query/result, scope/filter, history and exact indexed-destination artifact or implementation.
evidence.transformation: Notes example distinguishes local filters from app-wide search, clears private recents and opens the precise Spotlight note.
evidence.verification: Checks representative/no-result queries, cleared history, stale/deleted index content and external activation; wrong scope/destination fails.
evidence.applicability: Limits described Spotlight support to iOS/iPadOS/Mac while allowing broader app search; relevance/index freshness need execution evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Search fields handles entry UI and File management handles document metadata/Quick Look when relevant.
evidence.distinctiveness: Corpus scope, indexing provenance and exact result destinations distinguish finding strategy from field styling.
